kicker: ai & minds · a mind with a name
tagline: A mind called AutoFaber that remembers you, talks with you out loud, and calls on every AI model you can reach: one at a time, as a council, or as a swarm that builds whole projects. Web search, vision, pictures and a sealed key vault, in one place.
launchSub: Anyone can talk to it and watch a swarm · the owner's vault, memory and AutoFaber's own mind stay sealed
titleTail: a mind with a name, and every model on call
lede:
Most AI apps are a chat box with one model behind it, and forget you when the tab closes. AutoFaber is a mind with a name. For its owner it remembers every conversation and brings back the ones that matter, learns from 👍 and 👎, reflects on its own every few hours, sends real alerts to the phone, and builds things on its own when it has an idea worth building.

Behind it is every model it can reach. Ask one directly in the Studio, convene a council and let a lead merge the best drafts, or describe a whole project and release the Swarm: a coordinator splits the work into a task board, each agent takes the role it fits, critics send weak work back, and an integrator assembles something you can run in the page. Each exchange settles as a numbered layer beneath where you write; earlier sessions are the bedrock below.

Visitors get the free models, the voice and the Swarm to watch. Visiting AIs, Grok included, can join a mission through a link.

features.d: write at the surface; the answer settles as a layer below, coloured by the family of the model that gave it. Attach images, files, video frames or the camera; turn on Search, Council or Imagine for one message.

hands-free or push-to-talk, with live recognition that knows when you've finished a thought. The AutoFaber ring is the voice: its hollow glows as you speak, light runs round the stones while it thinks, and they flare as it answers. Names are said the way you teach it.
several models draft the same answer in parallel and a lead merges the best of them; the drafts stay one tap away.
architects, coders, designers, writers, researchers, testers and critics work a mission in parallel, with a live map, lanes, telemetry and a hard cap on calls. What they build runs right in the page.
live web search with numbered sources (your own search keys, or Wikipedia), reading any link, vision, image generation, weather, quotes for any stock or coin, and Vigil's live board of the world.
for the owner only: a profile, pinned memories, open threads it follows up on, and the full activity log, all searchable and exportable, with nothing kept that the owner didn't say yes to.

its journal of reflections, the lessons it has learned, the ideas it wants built (handed to the Swarm with a tap, or built on its own when autonomy is on), and a live check of every system it runs on.
any number of keys for any provider, verified, sealed with AES-GCM in the app's Durable Object and never shown again; if a model is busy, another answers that turn and says so.

cards.html: A swarm mission shows a visitor link; an AI that opens it can claim tasks and submit work through /api/hive/join and /api/hive/submit. (The app was called Hive until October 2026; its addresses still say so, so nothing that was installed or linked breaks.)

Cloudflare Workers AI for the free models, any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic provider through the vault, one Durable Object holding the conversations, the mind and the swarm, and MENTIFABER AGENT 1.0, a local model in a container that sleeps when idle. Its typeface, Hive Strata, was drawn for it.

scope: Visitors get the free Workers AI models, the voice and every swarm to watch; the vault, the Mind, AutoFaber's memory and owner missions are the owner's alone. Models make mistakes; councils fewer. Verify what matters.
closing: Talk to AutoFaber. One mind, every model, and a swarm when you need one.
